interpretation.bizproof_no_counterexample: formal verdict PROVED within the supported BIZPROOF semantics
interpretation.classification_accuracy: not reported for search-based baselines because absence of a counterexample is not a proof of correctness
interpretation.crosshair_no_counterexample: no counterexample reported within the configured analysis budget; reported as inconclusive on correct cases, not as a proof
interpretation.hypothesis_no_counterexample: no counterexample found within the configured search budget; reported as inconclusive on correct cases, not as a proof

interpretation.bizproof_proved: formal proof within the supported BIZPROOF semantics
interpretation.crosshair_no_counterexample: inconclusive under the configured symbolic-analysis budget
interpretation.hypothesis_no_counterexample: inconclusive under the configured search budget

interpretation.ADAPTATION_REQUIRED: business-relevant external function that requires an explicit interface or scalar adaptation before formal verification
interpretation.DIRECT_CANDIDATE: structurally close to the current BIZPROOF supported subset; still requires an independently sourced business contract
interpretation.UNSUPPORTED: contains control-flow or language constructs intentionally outside the current verifier semantics

external_semantic_validation.claim_scope: BIZPROOF verifies explicit scalar semantic adapters derived from locked external business-rule implementations and independently traceable tests/specifications. It does not claim end-to-end proof of the original frameworks.

adapter_semantic_preservation.method: AST extraction and execution of methods from locked external source files, differentially compared with V0.7 semantic adapters
adapter_semantic_preservation.claim_scope: V0.8 compares V0.7 adapters against methods extracted directly from the locked external source files and executed in controlled scalar harnesses. Zero observed mismatches is evidence of semantic preservation over the declared validation domains; it is not a universal proof outside those domains.

symbolic_adapter_equivalence.method: Symbolic translation of locked external AST semantic slices and SMT equivalence certification
symbolic_adapter_equivalence.claim_scope: V0.9 symbolically translates selected semantic slices directly from locked external Python ASTs and proves their equivalence to the corresponding V0.7 adapters over the declared BVC domains. For the Django-Oscar satisfaction case, the certified external slice is explicitly the post-aggregation threshold predicate, not the preceding basket aggregation loop.

evidence_carrying_certification.claim_scope: V0.10 certifies selected business-semantic slices only when their locked provenance, V0.7 contract verification evidence, V0.8 source-executed preservation evidence, and V0.9 symbolic equivalence evidence are mutually consistent. CERTIFIED does not mean that the complete external framework has been verified.

F0_DIRECT_SYMBOLIC.ci_interpretation: Approximate design-based interval under the preregistered hash-as-uniform stratified sampling assumption.
